messages.author: e60b4d9c1389d3d1
messages.subject: Robust CFI / TLI
parts:
Hello everyone,

I have a quick question.

When fitting the model with "MLM" estimator [to correct for non-normality], which one of the CFI / TLI (fit indices) do we use, the one under the "robust" column or the "robust CFI" and "robust TLI" values? As you can see, these values are different.

Looking forward to your guidance. 

Thank you.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Robust CFI / TLI
parts:
The ones in the Robust column simply use the robust chi-squared in the standard formulas.  The ones labeled "robust" in the left column are consistent estimates of their population counterparts.

https://doi.org/10.1080/00273171.2018.1455142

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
